title: Tenma Saki — For Our Next Show!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you all very much for gathering here today!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, we have practice today, so it's normal for us to be here...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is there something you'd like to discuss since you went through all this trouble?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! Mind if I get started...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, go for it!
Hehe. I wonder what we're gonna talk about...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, I hope you're all ready...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ta-daah♪
A notebook of “100 New Things I Want To Do”!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: 100 Things I Want To Do...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's the list you made when you were still in the hospital...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, really?
Tell me more☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sure. I made this list while I was in the hospital for when I'd be allowed to go back to school.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So that's what you meant by “100 Things I Want To Do”...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! And this one's for what we want to do as Leo/need, so let's start coming up with as many things as we can for it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Like... Here!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: “We're going pro!!”...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Across two pages too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, in a way, it sounds like a vow.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. This is at the top of our list, right? That's why I decided to write it first♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is gonna be all about the things we want to do together, so let's write down as many of our ideas and dreams as we can!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's so cool! I wanna write something!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But you're not in Leo/need.
This is just for them, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, us writing in this seems...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, sure♪

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi actually suggested that while we were picking out a notebook for this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. You've all been there for us throughout this process...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So what we want to do as a band also includes all of you, and we're hoping that we can make your wishes come true as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I brought lots of pens for us to use, so we can make everything look super cute, like this♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Lemme see! Lemme see! Oh wow! This pen's all sparkly and glittery inside! What's this stuff?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That one has glitter in the ink!
Everything you write becomes really sparkly♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's amazing! Sakki, can I try using this?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Of course! Here, you guys too!
Write as much as you want!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Saki and I already wrote down a few other things. If you turn to the page after, “We're going pro!!”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, here. Let's see...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
“Fill a live house with our fans.”
“Get a standing ovation!”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
A standing ovation...?
Live houses are usually standing room only.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, you too?! Ichi said the same thing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I get that we won't literally get a standing ovation. I just want to try to get a crowd going to that degree!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's very you, Saki.
I think I'll go with...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “Headline an event.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that's a pretty big goal!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it is. You really have to prove yourselves to others before you're given such an honor.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's true.
Why don't you write something, Shiho...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, how about...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “Get a crowd going with a set list of just our own songs...”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I like that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. Right now, it does sort of feel like we're relying a little too much on Miku songs.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I have nothing against playing covers.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But since we're trying to go pro, I want us to be able to do something like this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I agree!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's a wonderful goal to have...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You guys are so cool!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna think of something too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think I will too since we're all here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Great! We're gonna leave this here, so you guys can write in it anytime♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you have to mean what you write.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's true. We have to do our best to make these things a reality.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's do everything we can to make all of our hopes and dreams come true!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah!
